args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production version was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out` across all three regions.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms the service is now healthy: `checkout-api` is on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if it's ever redeployed it would require change-manager approval per policy — I did not deploy it, only rolled back.
